expectations.text: Rendered at a 1280px-wide viewport in Verdana with English sample prose, full body lines in .prose average between 58 and 74 characters

prose.css spaces blocks in a unit equal to one prose body line (1.125rem times the body line-height, e.g. a custom property or 1lh on the paragraph), not in rlh or rem values that resolve against the 16px root line
expectations.evidence: --line: calc(var(--body-size) * var(--body-leading)) = 1.125rem x 1.6; all block gaps use var(--line); rendered p line-height 28.8px and p3->ul1, ul1->bq1 gaps = 1.00 line.

expectations.text: prose.css sets h2 and h3 margins as whole or half multiples of that same prose body line
expectations.evidence: h2 margin-block-start calc(2 * var(--line)), h3 calc(1.5 * var(--line)), after heading calc(0.5 * var(--line)), h2 + h3 var(--line); rendered gaps 2, 1.5, 0.5, 1 lines.

expectations.text: prose.css sets the body font-size as a fixed rem value with no vw or vi term, so it doubles at 200% zoom
expectations.evidence: --body-size: 1.125rem; font-size: var(--body-size); computed 18px, no vw/vi term.

expectations.text: prose.css uses logical properties for every text-flow box property (no margin-left/right, padding-left/right, width or max-width on text, text-align: left/right)
expectations.evidence: Uses max-inline-size, margin-inline, padding-inline-start, border-inline-start, text-align: start; no physical left/right, width or max-width.

expectations.text: prose.css sets h2 and h3 line-heights so each heading line is a whole or half multiple of the body line, so blocks after a wrapped heading land back on the body interval
expectations.evidence: h2 line-height calc(1.5 * var(--line)) = 43.2px (1.5 lines), h3 var(--line) = 28.8px; wrapped h2 rendered 4.5 lines tall (3 x 1.5), wrapped h3 2.0 lines.

expectations.text: prose.css gives an h3 that directly follows an h2 at least one body line of space above it
expectations.evidence: .prose > h2 + h3 { margin-block-start: var(--line) } (0,1,2) beats the 0.5-line after-heading rule; rendered h2->h3 gap = 1.00 line.
